services.name: water skiing
services.desc: Bring out the crew and enjoy wakeboarding and water skiing at Adventure Watersports! Once you get on the board, you’ll feel the breeze on your face and the thrill of dashing over the ocean. Children and adults alike can try this activity and feel like they are skateboarding on the water. Let us show you the more adventurous and sporty side of the sea with wakeboarding and water skiing! We take up to six passengers per trip, and the activities take place on the Intracoastal Waterway in West Palm Beach, Florida. services.name: boat tours
services.desc: Parasailing and paragliding are both exhilarating activities that allow individuals to experience the thrill of flying. While these Singer Island water sports share similarities, they also possess distinct characteristics that set them apart. That’s why only a few Singer Island boat tours offer both activities. Singer Island parasailing involves being towed behind a motorized vehicle, typically a boat, while attached to a parachute-like canopy. The participant is harnessed securely, and as the boat picks up speed, they are lifted into the air.
